newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 4.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* News Corp said Monday it will narrow the focus of its HarperCollins business and take a $270 million one-time charge against earnings to cover restructuring costs.
* Norman Lear is moving toward the sale of his Act III Theatres Inc in a deal Wall Streeters believe could fetch as much as $550 million.
* Billy Bob Thornton is nearing deals to star in Paramount's "A Simple Plan" and Warner Bros.' "Jack Frost."
* George Clooney has fallen out of "Jack Frost," the project that was to be Warner Bros.' big 1998 holiday offering, and the studio is moving ahead with other casting options, such as John Travolta.
* Sony's "Men in Black" took in $20 million at foreign box offices this weekend, taking its overseas total to $52 million from 21 markets.
* Cable News Network is close to naming longtime ABC News Disney producer Rick Kaplan as CNN president, overseeing all operations at the network and reporting to CNN News Group CEO Tom Johnson.
